items: **Marriage**: socially approved union; ==legitimizes children==, creates kinship ties, regulates sexual behavior
**Nuclear** family: parents + children; **joint**: multiple generations together
Buddhist monks used kin terms for fellow monks: =='spiritual family'== (UPSC)

items: North: also **sasan**/**sapinda** bars; brides go to ==higher-status families==
